summary: Backend + frontend verification of the centralized RAB workflow closure (History, Coordinator SPD checklist, PIC Realisasi, PIC/Sekretaris inbox). All 5 requested behaviors PASS end-to-end. Live-drive on public URL: created rab-ced55b972b, marched it Koordinator->SPV->Manager->Sekretaris(booked)->Koordinator(spd_done) via API and UI, then completed realisasi from /realisasi, and it appeared in /history. Backend tests: 9/9 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_rab_workflow.py.

minor.issue: Legacy 'TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI' rows (5 in current DB) still returned; they are from a superseded workflow and are surfaced in Sekretaris inbox by the current status filter. Consider migration or explicit history treatment.

ui_bugs.issue: Every PIC row - including SIAP REALISASI PIC and MENUNGGU SPD KOORDINATOR - renders identical CTA 'Revisi & ajukan ulang' with href='/ai-travel'. History/informational statuses should not carry the Revisi CTA; SIAP REALISASI PIC should route to /realisasi (or at minimum be labeled 'Lihat realisasi').
Booked history rows (MENUNGGU SPD KOORDINATOR, TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI) mixed with actionable MENUNGGU PEMESANAN rows using the same CTA - no visual grouping between actionable vs history.
Single-line JSX return (hard to review); no confirmation dialog before checklist action; no error toast on failure.

File input is present but never uploaded/validated - completeRabRealization is called without any receipt payload. Task note said 'dummy proof metadata is expected' so this is acceptable, but the input is misleading UX.
No filters, no timestamp column, no status badge distinction - just title + status. Adequate as MVP.

issues: Actionable vs informational rows visually indistinguishable

action_items: In CentralInboxPage, branch CTA per status: PERLU REVISI PIC -> /ai-travel Revisi; SIAP REALISASI PIC -> /realisasi 'Selesaikan realisasi'; MENUNGGU SPD KOORDINATOR/TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI -> informational (no CTA or 'Lihat detail').
Split inbox into 'Perlu tindakan' vs 'Riwayat' groups with distinct headings and data-testids.
Backfill legacy TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI submissions to MENUNGGU SPD KOORDINATOR or expose them as history.
critical_code_review_comments: All four target pages (SpdMonitoringPage, CentralRealizationPage, HistoryPage, CentralInboxPage) return single-line JSX; readability suffers.
CentralRealizationPage: proof file is captured but never sent to backend; completeRabRealization has no payload - misleading UX.
Backend uses two parallel data models (trips + rab_submissions); the centralized flow is complete on rab_submissions but /trips endpoints/pages remain and can confuse future maintainers.
action_rab_submission: the 'booked' action check is implicit (falls into 'else: next_status'); consider validating (status,action) pairs explicitly.
resubmit_rab_submission endpoint exists but resubmitRabSubmission caller was still not wired from the wizard as of last iteration - verify.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 requested behaviors functionally pass; UX branching issues remain

seed_data_creation: Live-created rab-ced55b972b (SELESAI REALISASI) and rab-* SIAP REALISASI PIC fixtures via API during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Centralized workflow lifecycle is now complete: MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR -> MENUNGGU SPV -> MENUNGGU MANAGER -> MENUNGGU PEMESANAN -> MENUNGGU SPD KOORDINATOR -> SIAP REALISASI PIC -> SELESAI REALISASI. Endpoints POST /rab-submissions/{id}/action (booked, spd_done) and POST /rab-submissions/{id}/realization-complete + GET /rab-history all working. Pages: /monitoring (Koordinator, data-testid=spd-monitoring-page, complete-spd-{id}), /realisasi (PIC, data-testid=central-realization-page, complete-realization-{id}), /history (all roles, data-testid=history-page). Main remaining UX debt is per-status CTA branching in CentralInboxPage.
rca of the issue: Prior iterations were missing the Koordinator SPD queue page and the PIC realisasi page against rab_submissions. Both are now implemented as SpdMonitoringPage and CentralRealizationPage with matching backend endpoints. History uses new /api/rab-history filter for SELESAI REALISASI/HISTORY statuses.
